text_block_list.text:
After going out with Super Creek, I head 
over to the library.

Just as I promised Super Creek, I kept 
studying training methods at a sensible 
pace. Then one day—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We did it, Trainer. My time improved~.
choice_data_list: This is the fruit of Creek's hard work!
This is all thanks to Creek's hard work!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy that I could live up to all 
your hard work, Trainer. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Look. Trainer-san, that person over 
there...

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah... Trainer, I... My time didn't 
improve, um... I-I'm so—

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
This happened because I lack the necessary 
skill as a Trainer. It's not your fault.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Let's call it a day here. I'll think up 
some new training by next time.

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Then, um... me too...

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...No. Thank you for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You're the Trainer who approached me 
before, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
“...*sigh* What on earth should I do...? 
At this rate, she's going to suffer 
because of me...”
choice_data_list: We should talk this through more

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What are you suddenly... wait. Were 
you girls... listening?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. I happened to overhear.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
However... I agree with the Trainer as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
"Mind your own business. I have no 
intention of blaming my own shortcomings 
on the Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Call it uncalled-for if you wish. ...Even 
so, let me tell you that you are wrong."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Just as I think of you, Trainer... I'm 
sure that girl wants to talk with you too.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I want to understand your pain, Trainer, 
even just a little... I want to share the 
burden with you."

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...My pain?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, certainly.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Still, telling her something like that 
would be...
choice_data_list:
There are some things you just can't solve 
on your own.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If you get to know each other more deeply, 
you might be able to find a solution from 
there.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Being on the track isn't everything there 
is to her... To an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, you're right. That must be it... 
Thank you... First, I'll try talking to 
them.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text:
And also... I'm sorry for saying those 
terrible things before.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Because you called out to them, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure the two of them will develop a 
wonderful relationship, just like us."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You really are kind, Trainer. There, 
there, good boy♪

...Getting to know each other is 
important, but I feel like I'm being 
pampered a bit too much. I need to reflect 
on this and, from now on—
choice_data_list: I won't let myself get spoiled!

I'm going to become a Trainer you can rely 
on even more!
I'm the one who's going to pamper Creek!
I'll be the one to spoil Creek!

text_block_list.text:
...Getting to know each other is 
important, but I feel like I'm being 
pampered a bit too much. I need to reflect 
on this and, from now on—
choice_data_list: I won't let myself get spoiled!

I'm going to become a Trainer you can rely 
on even more!
I'm the one who's going to pamper Creek!
I'll be the one to spoil Creek!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Huh, why is that?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No way... Trainer isn't going to let me 
pamper them anymore...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sad and lonely... I'm going to 
burst into tears...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I might not even be able to do my best in 
training... *sniff*

When I hurriedly took back what I said, 
Super Creek gave a mischievous giggle...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. If you become any more reliable, I 
won't be able to look after you anymore.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
However, there are still those who don't 
know how dependable you are, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In order for more people to know about it, 
I must prove it through my running.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"I'm looking forward to the day when 
everyone gets to know you, Trainer♪"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My! If you're willing to spoil me, does 
that mean...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
In other words, Trainer, you're going to 
let me spoil you a whole lot, right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, that makes me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My sweet and adorable Trainer. I'll 
continue to spoil you so, so much♪

Even when I denied it and said that wasn't 
the case, Super Creek just pretended not 
to hear and brushed it aside...
